input: Get the gutters cleaned before the wet season

gold.taskTitle: Get Gutters Cleaned Before Wet Season
gold.taskDescription: Clean the gutters on the user's property in preparation for the upcoming wet season.

questions.title: When exactly does your local wet season begin?
questions.description: Identify the target deadline date so the task can be scheduled with enough lead time.

questions.title: Will you do this yourself or hire someone?
questions.description: Determine whether the plan involves a DIY approach or finding and booking a professional service.

questions.title: How many stories tall is your home?
questions.description: Understand the height and access difficulty involved, which affects safety requirements and equipment needed.

questions.title: What is the total linear footage of your gutters?
questions.description: Establish the scale of the job to estimate time, cost, and effort required.

questions.title: When were the gutters last cleaned or inspected?
questions.description: Gauge the current condition and likely level of debris buildup to set expectations.

questions.title: Do any gutters have known damage or clogs right now?
questions.description: Identify whether repairs are needed alongside cleaning, which may affect who to hire or what materials to buy.

questions.title: Do you have a budget in mind for this job?
questions.description: Understand financial constraints so the plan can recommend appropriately priced options or services.
